summary: Checkpoint large evidence pulls so interrupted verification resumes from a signed partial head

replay.detail: No graph replay changes. Interrupted evidence pulls retain signed checkpoints and resume verification of the remaining refs.

schema.detail: No database or evidence log format changes. Existing signed log commits and copy refs remain readable.

rules.detail: Evidence trust and fast-forward publication requirements are preserved for every checkpoint.

compatibility.detail: Existing verifiers read checkpoint heads without changes. The existing trusted-key, ancestry and leased fast-forward publication checks apply to every checkpoint.

downtime.detail: No daemon downtime. Verification checkpoints after 500 refs or 120 seconds, and stamps each commit when made.

manual.detail: The existing evidence-log-timer reads the updated publisher from main. No configuration changes are needed.

recovery.detail: Interrupted evidence pulls retain signed checkpoints and resume verification of remaining refs. Log heads precede copy markers, so interruption can cause re-verification but cannot skip an absent log line. Revert without converting stored data. Crash-damaged object repair is handled separately.
